title.zh: 横屏完整显示导师照片并修复手机语言弹窗边界
title.en: Show complete tutor portraits and fit the phone language menu

purpose.zh: 横屏宽容器保持导师照片原始比例、左右留白，并修正手机 WebKit 检出的语言菜单轻微越界。
purpose.en: Preserve each tutor portrait's natural ratio with white side space in landscape and fix the phone language menu overflow found by WebKit.

zh: 三张导师照片按已核实的原图尺寸显示，使用 contain 并在宽屏左右留白。
移除会压扁照片区域的 16:9 加最大高度组合，也移除说话时放大导致的边缘裁切。
手机语言菜单按 SmartLingo 的页头留白缩窄，保持 Guandan 的弹窗结构和点击外部关闭行为。
en: Render the three verified tutor photos at their source dimensions with contain fitting and white side space on wide screens.
Remove the conflicting 16:9 plus max-height panel sizing and the speaking zoom that could trim image edges.
Narrow the phone language popover for SmartLingo's header gutters while retaining Guandan's menu structure and outside-click dismissal.

zh: 旗舰版实时导师照片及手机语言弹窗宽度；不改通话、导师偏好、账户或付款。
en: The Max live tutor portrait display and phone language popover width; no changes to calls, preferences, accounts, or payments.

zh: 为现有三张照片登记真实宽高，不换图或导师选项。
照片区域使用固定的视口内高度与白底，图像保持完整比例居中；保留悬浮箭头、音色、字幕和通话按钮位置。
将 420px 以下的语言菜单宽度限定为视口减去页头控件留白，消除 390px WebKit 的左边缘 -3px 越界。
en: Record the true width and height of the three existing portrait files without changing images or tutor choices.
Use a viewport-bounded white stage and centered full-ratio image; preserve photo arrows, voice selection, transcript, and call controls.
At widths below 420px, bound the language menu to viewport width minus header-control gutters, removing the -3px left overflow measured by 390px WebKit.

zh: 站点策略门禁、TypeScript、零警告 lint、全套测试、构建与中英文 WebKit 响应式检查。
发布后实测桌面及手机宽度下的照片完整性、手机语言弹窗边界与关闭，并核对精确 Project 发布记录。
en: Site policy gates, TypeScript, zero-warning lint, full tests, build, and Chinese/English responsive WebKit checks.
After deployment, inspect complete portraits at wide and phone widths plus phone language-menu bounds and dismissal, then verify the exact Project release record.

zh: 无付款、账户或实时语音行为变更。
en: No payment, account, or live-voice behavior changes.

zh: 沿用 SmartLingo 的十三个界面语言、学习语言和现有导师照片。
en: Preserve SmartLingo's thirteen interface locales, learning-language selection, and existing tutor photos.

rollback.zh: 回退到上一部署提交；数据库无变更。
rollback.en: Deploy the prior commit; no database change is involved.
